title: Scrunchie
desc: A Turquerie-inspired scrunchie featuring an original butterfly motif. Made from a silky, fast-drying synthetic satin, it holds shape beautifully while adding a subtle sheen to the hair. The pattern’s blend of elegance and playfulness makes it suitable for both everyday wear and special styling.
notes: Designed using an original Turquerie-inspired butterfly motif.
Made from a lightweight synthetic satin that dries quickly and keeps its shape.
Soft elasticity provides a comfortable but secure hold.
Adds a refined touch to both casual and dressed-up hairstyles.
material: Fast-drying synthetic satin with a smooth, silky surface.
shipping: Orders are packed and shipped directly from my studio. Shipping time may vary depending on location and order volume.
care: Hand wash or machine wash on gentle cycle. Air drying is recommended to preserve the fabric’s sheen and elasticity.
